hook: NGC 4569's gas tail dates its stripping by the Virgo Cluster to about 250 million years ago.
summary: A fast orbit-reconstruction model fits the positions and velocities of the galaxy and 94 Halpha regions, plus cluster gravity and hot gas density, to find when ram pressure peaked (about 163 Myr ago). The galaxy's line-of-sight distance is unknown, so the fit splits into a pre-peak and a post-peak branch, and only an independent stripping-radius check favors the post-peak one. Results depend on that assumed distance and on a spherical cluster model.
title: A Virgo Environmental Survey Tracing Ionised Gas Emission (VESTIGE). XXIII. NGC 4569 past orbit reconstruction with ORFEO
